q1_issues.issue: The "during" PP is encoded as (Time sk_dim_1 sk_nights_1), but the instruction set makes During the head for exactly during/while/throughout, and Time's value slot takes structured calendar terms or bare deictic/day-part symbols, never an entity witness.

notes: The witness reading of "an apprentice" (indefinite under a verbal predicate), both Possession genitives, the group witness for the possessed plural, the change-of-state Patient on "dims" and the unmarked habitual are all correct. (Inheritance solo_night solo) is doubtful: the modifier genus is licensed only for a gradable, positional/cardinal or material adjective, and "solo" is shaky on the "the night is solo" predication test.
